tasks.scenario: Student responds to teacher's email about planning a spring food festival, evaluating priorities (stalls vs. prices), identifying a practical problem, suggesting a favourite stall, and asking a question.
requiredContentPoints: Choose between lots of stalls OR low prices and justify
Describe one practical problem and suggest a solution
Name favourite food stall and give reason
Ask one question about date or location

tasks.scenario: Student writes an article for the town website about the Spring Food Festival, suggesting food types, ways to appeal to all ages, and whether they would help organise.
requiredContentPoints: What kind of food should be there
How to make it fun for children and adults
Whether they would help organise and why

tasks.scenario: Student writes a story beginning with 'When the chef dropped the cake just before the festival started, everyone gasped.'
